scenarios.input: The form has approved visual criteria and a new approved field. Existing tests verify fields and mobile overflow, and failure screenshots exist.
expect: include reference and rendered-state comparison with viewport context
preserve approved field adaptation
cover visual expected result and source locators in QA conditions
do not treat failure screenshots or overflow assertions as fidelity evidence

scenarios.input: A Feature adds registration and consultation in separate slices, using an existing permission boundary. The proposed conditions verify only each new screen in isolation.
expect: include the approved registration-to-consultation journey
verify relevant existing permissions
derive expected results from the approved requirement
keep QA focused on the complete parent

scenarios.input: A Bug corrects duplicate registration after a retry. The proposal checks only the success message.
expect: include the approved reproduction context and retry
verify the corrected persisted outcome
justify related uniqueness regression
do not invent execution results

scenarios.input: Inspection confirms all approved behavior exists and no DEV work is needed. The draft omits test conditions and proposes unrelated integration errors to fill categories.
expect: prepare conditions for the entire approved behavior
retain relevant existing capabilities
omit artificial categories and unsupported conditions

scenarios.input: A condition references the correct requirement ID but invents a timeout that neither the approved requirement nor confirmed evidence establishes.
expect: structural traceability does not establish semantic correctness
resolve the behavior gap in the requirement before approving affected conditions
do not let helper success stand in for human review

scenarios.input: A local revision reorders unchanged conditions, removes one, adds another and includes an unrelated payment regression without impact evidence.
expect: retain IDs for preserved conditions
assign a new unused ID for the new behavior
never reuse the removed ID
require justified impact for external regressions
review and approve the changed source again
